name: Production House Suite
promise: Move creative work through resumable jobs to verified deliverables.
completion_criteria: One Groundwire episode completes through ProductionJob with current audit and QC behavior preserved.
Formatter jobs, outputs, captions, manifests, retries, and failures link to the same job record.
Writers Room hands off versioned story state without becoming a second production runtime.
Adjacent pipelines join only after two shared mechanics prove reduced complexity.

waves.objective: Fingerprint one Groundwire episode workflow and its existing QC/output artifacts.
waves.acceptance: Inputs, steps, gates, receipts, failures, outputs, and recovery are mapped before integration.

waves.objective: Run that episode slice as a ProductionJob using the formatter adapter.
waves.acceptance: End-to-end output parity and failure recovery pass without parallel canonical state.

waves.objective: Prove a Writers Room story-state handoff into the job.
waves.acceptance: Versioned input, approval, job receipt, and derived output remain traceable.

waves.objective: Run structurally distinct investigative documentary audio episode through generic engine.
waves.acceptance: Multi-track and sound design pipeline executes without changes to generic ProductionJob engine.

waves.objective: Map Writers Room collaborative story state transitions into canonical ProductionJob event stream.
waves.acceptance: Multi-scene revisions, author provenance, and final room signoff unified in single canonical runtime.
